FN-YYOANN-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 365
Committee: Ways and Means General Fund Sponsor: Representative Brock Colvin
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 04/24/2023
House Bill 365 as introduced would exempt qualified disabled veterans from paying certain
issuance fees for a driver’s license ($36.25), duplicate license ($15), or the driver’s license
examination ($5), which could decrease receipts to the following funds by the following
estimated maximum annually amounts, based on the total number of qualified disabled veterans
as provided in the table below:
Fund Yearly Revenue Loss
State General Fund $316,069
Probate Judges and Counties $ 35,119
Highway Safety Fund $485,809
Alabama Veterans' Living Legacy Trust Fund $ 11,706
Total $848,703
Page 1

FN-YYOANN-2
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 365
Committee: Ways and Means General Fund Sponsor: Representative Brock Colvin
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 05/24/2023
House Bill 365 as reported by the Committee on Ways and Means General Fund would exempt
honorably discharged disabled veterans from paying certain issuance fees for a driver’s license
($36.25), duplicate license ($15), or the driver’s license examination ($5), which could decrease
receipts to the following funds by the following estimated maximum annually amounts, based
on the total number of honorably discharged disabled veterans as provided in the table below:
Fund Yearly Revenue Loss
State General Fund $316,069
Probate Judges and Counties $ 35,119
Highway Safety Fund $485,809
Alabama Veterans' Living Legacy Trust Fund $ 11,706
Total $848,703
